focus.jbig: FOMC hike tomorrow · oil holds ~$107 · Hormuz standoff · futures steady
focus.jtag: The Fed decides Wednesday with a ~91% chance of a 25bp hike; Brent holds near $107 on the Hormuz standoff, but a supply-easing comment let futures recover overnight
focus.jnote: The tape sits in wait-and-see mode one day before the Fed. The dominant catalyst is the FOMC decision Wednesday 9/16 at 2:00 ET, where markets price a ~91% chance of a 25bp hike to 3.75–4.00% — what would be the first hike of 2026 — released with an updated SEP/dot plot; Retail Sales lands at 8:30 ET the same morning. Brent crude holds near $107 after topping a 4-month high, kept bid by the Saudi East-West pipeline shutdown and the Hormuz standoff, though an overnight comment that ~17M bbl still flowed through Hormuz eased supply fears and let equity futures recover from early losses. Gold slid below $4,300 (~$4,263) as the dollar firmed and the 10-year pushed toward ~4.8–5.0%. An oil-tinged tape stacked on a live rate decision one day out is not a premium-selling setup.
focus.notdown: Energy (XLE, XOM, MPC, OXY) and Defense (LMT, RTX, NOC) keep a structural oil/war-premium bid as Brent holds near $107. But be honest: these are two-sided war trades, not clean Snipers — the same Hormuz-easing headline that lifted futures overnight can gap energy straight back down. Watch-only, not table-pounders.
focus.notup: Semiconductors & AI names (NVDA, AMD, and the broad chip complex) remain the pressured group after the recent AI-slowdown call and higher yields, with rotation out of AI names continuing. But selling bear calls into an FOMC one day out carries violent-squeeze risk on any dovish surprise or hold — the disciplined answer is to sell nothing new today.
focus.why: Why RED? Composite 64 is squarely WARM and P(≥1% gap) at 46% is well above the 35% trigger — either one alone locks out GREEN. More important: the FOMC (9/16) lands inside a normal DTE with a ~91% hike priced plus a dot-plot and Retail Sales, and an unresolved oil/Hormuz backdrop keeps the overnight tail wider. The one boarded name (USO) is flagged illiquid / OI-thin (460) / next-earnings N/A / liquidity-unverified. Stand down on new credit spreads, or if you must be positioned, use short DTE that clears the FOMC and cut size hard. Cash is a position today.
